Use the same Concentric Signal/stitched Ground system as the
[Q3D notebook](aedt_q3d.ipynb), now in an HFSS Eigenmode design.
Inspect the enclosed 3D model before deciding its mode-search settings.
This example has no junction, lumped load, drive port or EPR request; it is not
yet a qubit-frequency calculation.
See the [TSV guide](../../../../simulation/tsv-model-inspection.qmd) and
[Eigenmode requirement](../../../../simulation/requirements/eigenmode.qmd).

Use this OrPen source candidate with the fixed
[SCGSim checkpoint](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/tree/c9270c7e76e0b2df187dddde462079e00d410dd0)
in an isolated Python 3.12/3.13 runtime. The native stage uses AEDT 2024 R2 /
PyAEDT 1.3.0. No ordinary dependency pin is changed here.

## Setup and Imports

Public source and model-record imports do not open an AEDT Desktop.

## Setup and Run Controls

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-controls
import hashlib
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from IPython.display import display
from scgsim.aedt import (
    prepare_hfss_eigenmode_from_geometry,
    prepare_planar_geometry_input,
    resolve_prepared_model,
)
from scgsim.geometry import GeometryBuildInput, LayoutPolygonSpec, SemanticEntitySpec

import orpen_sc_pdk
from orpen_sc_pdk.cells import get_tsv_source_records, tsv_concentric_signal_coupon

WORKFLOW_ACTION = "source"  # source | prepare_handoff | build_model | inspect_model
DIE = "D0"
DIE_SIDE_UM = 1000.0
BORE_DIAMETER_UM = 60.0
WALL_THICKNESS_UM = 0.2
SIGNAL_OUTER_RADIUS_UM = 100.0
GAP_UM = 20.0
GROUND_TSV_OFFSET_UM = 300.0
MODEL = "thin_film"
RUN_CONTROL = None
RUN_ID = f"tsv-concentric-eigenmode-{uuid4().hex[:12]}"
OUTPUT_ROOT = Path(".artifacts/SCGSimExamples/TSV")
RUN_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / RUN_ID
SOURCE_DIR = OUTPUT_ROOT / f"{RUN_ID}-source"
RETURNED_RUN_DIR = None  # Explicit actual returned run for fresh-kernel inspect_model.
PROJECT_NAME = "TSVConcentricEigenmodeThinFilmModelOnly"
DESIGN_NAME = "Eigenmode"
REGION_PADDING_XYZ_UM = (250.0, 250.0, 1000.0)
GEOMETRY_WORKERS = 1
RESOURCES = None  # No solver HPC request; model-process allocation is arranged separately.
SIGNAL_ENTITY_IDS = (f"{DIE}/TOP_SIGNAL", f"{DIE}/BOTTOM_SIGNAL", f"{DIE}/SIGNAL_WALL")
GROUND_ENTITY_IDS = (f"{DIE}/TOP_GROUND", f"{DIE}/BACK_GROUND") + tuple(
    f"{DIE}/GROUND_TSV_{i}" for i in range(4)
)
orpen_sc_pdk.activate()
display({name: version(name) for name in ("orpen-sc-pdk", "gdsfactory", "scgsim")})
```

`source` stays at layout/source records; `prepare_handoff` performs backend
input preparation; `build_model` executes only the native model transaction.
`inspect_model` reads a returned package without rebuilding it. Resource flags
are not a CAD/aggregate hard cap; native execution needs an available allocation.

## Create Simulation Component / Coupon

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-coupon
if WORKFLOW_ACTION != "inspect_model":
    coupon = tsv_concentric_signal_coupon(
        die=DIE,
        die_side_um=DIE_SIDE_UM,
        bore_diameter_um=BORE_DIAMETER_UM,
        wall_thickness_um=WALL_THICKNESS_UM,
        signal_outer_radius_um=SIGNAL_OUTER_RADIUS_UM,
        gap_um=GAP_UM,
        ground_tsv_offset_um=GROUND_TSV_OFFSET_UM,
    )
    coupon.plot()
```

The central hollow wall joins the two annular Signal pads by source intent;
four outer hollow walls join the Ground planes. Silicon is explicitly cut at
all five bores. M1 and substrate thickness come from the selected PDK levels.

## Initialize AEDT Project / App

The later `build_model` CLI initializes its own HFSS Eigenmode Desktop/design.
Source authoring below does not attach to an existing Human or solver session.

{{< include _source_input.qmd >}}

## Simulation Configuration

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-handoff
HANDOFF = None
if WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"prepare_handoff", "build_model"}:
    geometry = prepare_planar_geometry_input(build_input, prepared_stack=stack, modeling=MODEL)
    HANDOFF = prepare_hfss_eigenmode_from_geometry(
        modeling=MODEL,
        geometry=geometry,
        project_name=PROJECT_NAME,
        design_name=DESIGN_NAME,
        run_control=RUN_CONTROL,
        output_dir=RUN_DIR,
        geometry_workers=GEOMETRY_WORKERS,
        resources=RESOURCES,
    )
    display(HANDOFF)
```

The surrounding Region follows the explicit enclosure. Closed HFSS exterior
treatment is retained: no Radiation or PML is requested. `None` does not create
an Analysis Setup, search frequency, mode count or adaptive pass settings.
Thin Film affects face metal only; vertical TSV walls retain their finite volume.

## Solve and Export

**Model-only: no solve.** The CLI performs build/readback/save/release only.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-native
if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "build_model":
    subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "scgsim.aedt.run",
            "--handoff",
            str(HANDOFF.metadata_path),
            "--execute",
            "--prepare-only",
        ],
        check=True,
    )
```

## Adaptive-Pass Convergence / Solver Diagnostics

No adaptive pass or eigenmode search has occurred. Preserve native preparation
errors and missing readbacks; do not retry or fabricate a convergence history.

## Results: Plots and Readable Tables

### Physics Analysis Results

Inspect sheet versus solid bodies, source/effective Z, the five Silicon bores,
empty TSV centers and material assignments. No eigenfrequency, mode, Q, field
or participation is expected. Native contact/query missingness is not evidence
of electrical continuity.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-readback
PREPARED_MODEL = None
if WORKFLOW_ACTION == "inspect_model":
    PREPARED_MODEL = resolve_prepared_model(RETURNED_RUN_DIR)
    display(PREPARED_MODEL.project_path)
    display(PREPARED_MODEL.readback)
```

### Simulation Performance / Benchmarks

Preserve actual preparation, save and owned-session release evidence. There
are no adaptive histories or solved benchmarks in this model-only stage.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-eigenmode-model-stage
if PREPARED_MODEL is not None:
    display({"mode": PREPARED_MODEL.mode, "model_stage": PREPARED_MODEL.model_stage})
```

## Save and Release AEDT

The native transaction saves and releases its own Desktop. Open a separate
writable project copy with its necessary companions for Human geometry review;
do not edit the hash-bound producer. Earlier Solid projects retain their own
execution identity and are not current notebook outputs.
